explanation: Retain both the largest and smallest products ending at the previous value. Multiplication by a negative number can swap their roles; compare both extensions with starting a new subarray.
spaceComplexity: O(n) auxiliary space for the sliced suffix; the recurrence itself uses O(1) state.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 JavaScript algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
